correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md, geometric S_n-fixed simplices are orbit-barycenter combinations of full Hamming-weight orbits, not fixed original vertices. Independent weight-distance calculations give diam(W_i)=2min(i,n-i), max cross-layer distance=min(i+j,2n-i-j); hence the fixed model is Ind of a bipartite band graph |i-j|<t=n-r. Inspecting the explicit fold proof and verify_fixed_rips.py, left/right neighbor containments successively reduce to s+1 disjoint edges where s=floor(floor(r/2)/(n-r)), making a cross-polytope boundary S^s for all 0<=r<n. The complement involution cannot fix a point and Lefschetz gives degree (-1)^(s+1). n=1,r=0 and r>=n agree with the exact models. The 55 direct orbit comparisons, 1,220 fold sequence checks and 28 explicit collapses in the saved verifier output corroborate, rather than replace, the unbounded argument.
